# Eneco

> > Eneco is a leading Dutch sustainable energy provider offering 100% green electricity from HollandseWind & Zon®, district heating solutions, and innovative energy contracts.

Eneco delivers renewable energy to households and businesses across the Netherlands, with services including dynamic and fixed-rate contracts, district heating networks (Warmte van Eneco), solar panel support, and the HappyPower loyalty program through the Eneco app. The company focuses on climate-neutral solutions and helping customers transition to gas-free living.

## Key Topics

- Groene stroom (100% green electricity)
- HollandseWind & Zon® (Dutch wind and solar)
- Eneco Dynamisch (dynamic pricing contracts)
- Warmtepomp (heat pumps)
- Stadswarmte (district heating)
- Energiecontract (energy contracts)
- Mijn Eneco (customer portal)
- HappyPower loyalty program
- Terugleverkosten (solar feed-in costs)
- Klimaatneutraal (climate neutral)
- Vast contract (fixed-rate contracts)
- Variabel contract (variable contracts)
- Energie besparen (energy saving)
- Duurzame energie (sustainable energy)
- Elektrisch rijden (electric driving)

## Energy Contracts & Pricing

- [Energieleverancier Eneco - duurzame energie van iedereen](https://www.eneco.nl): Homepage for Eneco, Dutch sustainable energy provider with green electricity
- [Onze energieprijzen: dit betaal je voor Stroom & Gas](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/energieprijzen): Energy pricing overview for electricity and gas contracts and tariffs
- [Groene Stroom contract afsluiten: kies voor HollandseWind & Zon®](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/stroom): 100% green electricity contracts from Dutch wind and solar sources
- [Ontdek binnen 1 minuut welk energiecontract bij je past](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/keuze-energiecontract): Energy contract selection tool comparing fixed, dynamic, and variable options
- [Flexibiliteit met een variabel energiecontract](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/variabel-energiecontract): Variable energy contract with flexible market-based pricing and no lock-in
- [Jaarcontract energie afsluiten: zekerheid in de winter](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/vast-contract-energie/jaarcontract-energie): One-year fixed energy contract with guaranteed winter pricing certainty
- [Spoedaanvraag energie: binnen 24 uur energie](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/snel-energie): Emergency energy request service with 24-hour activation for urgent needs

## Sustainable Heating & Cooling Solutions

- [Eneco Warmte en Koeling: met Stadswarmte ben je klaar voor de toekomst](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/warmte-koeling): District heating and cooling network for gas-free sustainable urban living
- [Winterklaar in de zomer](https://www.eneco.nl/campagnes/winterklaar-in-de-zomer): Campaign article on winter home preparation with heat pumps and insulation

## Getting Started & Customer Guides

- [Eerste energiecontract afsluiten](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/energiecontract-afsluiten/eerste-energiecontract-afsluiten): Step-by-step guide for signing up for your first energy contract with Eneco
- [HappyPower](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/happypower): Customer loyalty program offering free electricity rewards via Eneco app
- [Terugleverkosten](https://www.eneco.nl/duurzame-energie/vast-contract-energie/zonnepanelen-en-terugleverkosten): Solar panel feed-in costs and electricity return delivery explained

## Customer Support
